summary: Round 3 testing completed. All 13 backend tests passed after fixing MongoDB _id serialization bug in review endpoints. Frontend UI tests verified all Round 3 features working correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 3 features all implemented and tested: 1) 'Zones de livraison' removed from header (kept in footer), 2) New products added: Manioc, Foufou, Semoule de maïs (African), Chips de plantain, Bonbons tropicaux, Sucre de canne (Caribbean), 3) Categories reordered with Épicerie Africaine and Caribéenne first, 4) Product reviews visible in detail modal with clickable count, 5) All 22 products have seeded reviews, 6) Careers page: no spontaneous form, CV upload in job detail, 7) Driver review endpoint POST /api/reviews/driver works with +5 loyalty points, 8) Driver info endpoint GET /api/driver/{name}/info returns profile, 9) ScrollToTop component implemented. Fixed MongoDB _id serialization bug in review endpoints.
